name: Render resolution 1280x720, output 1280x720
description: Output and render resolution 1280x720. Choose Performance in the game's graphics settings first: this patch replaces the sizes the game computes for that mode. The first two writes are the display mode (the game's default output is 3840x2160), the last two the render size of the Performance mode. Both are held: the game writes them again later and the patch follows. Only for the KytyPS5 fork (`recomp_patch.py kyty`, then `--game-patch`). Use only one variant.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: KytyPS5 fork (2026-11-17, commits up to 2066efea), bank scene of the prologue, RTX 3050 laptop GPU (8 GB), Ryzen 5 3600: 59.8 fps in two 400 s runs (the display's 60 Hz limit), right picture. Those runs also had a local change that makes Performance the default graphics mode for a new profile; with the mode chosen in the menu instead it has not been run yet.
